# Example Domain

The page is the reserved example domain of the IANA. It carries a single
paragraph saying that the domain exists for use in documentation and examples,
that no coordination with anyone is needed to reference it, and a link to the
IANA page about reserved domains.

Ingested here so the fixture has one document from a `type: web` source: the
tests care about the shape of this file — frontmatter with `url:` instead of
`path:`, one document per page — not about what the page says.
